DNDAMIGOS.SettingsMenu.Name: D&D Amigos Connection
DNDAMIGOS.SettingsMenu.Label: Configure Connection
DNDAMIGOS.SettingsMenu.Hint: Site URL, API key, which campaign this world is linked to, and the shared Loot actor.
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.SiteUrl.Name: D&D Amigos Site URL
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.SiteUrl.Hint: e.g. https://dndamigos.com — no dash (not dnd-amigos.com), no trailing slash.
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.ApiKey.Name: Foundry API Key
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.ApiKey.Hint: Matches FOUNDRY_API_KEY in the site's engine/config.php. Treat it like a password.
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.JournalId.Name: Linked Journal ID
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.JournalId.Hint: The numeric id of the D&D Amigos campaign journal this world corresponds to.
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.LootActorId.Name: Loot Actor
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.LootActorId.Hint: Optional — pick this world's shared party-loot actor (a PF2e "Loot" sheet). When set, adding loot through Manage Loot drops the item here too, not just on the site.
DNDAMIGOS.IdentityMenu.Name: My D&D Amigos Identity
DNDAMIGOS.IdentityMenu.Label: Set My Identity
DNDAMIGOS.IdentityMenu.Hint: Pick which D&D Amigos member you are, so loot and session posts get credited to you.
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.MyUserId.Name: I am
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.MyUserId.Hint: This is saved per-browser, not per-world — set it once on each device you use.
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.LegacyWindows.Name: Use legacy windows
DNDAMIGOS.Settings.LegacyWindows.Hint: Only if a D&D Amigos window will not open or looks broken: draw the module's windows with Foundry's older window type instead of the newer one. Applies to this browser only.

DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.CreateNewHint: Or create a brand-new Character Vault entry from this actor's current name/level/abilities/HP/AC — credited to whichever D&D Amigos member you've set as your identity (Configure Settings → My D&D Amigos Identity), so you can edit it yourself on the site afterward.

DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.ReSyncBody: This overwrites this actor's current level/HP/abilities with what's on the site right now. Continue?
DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.PushConfirmBody: This overwrites "{name}" on the site with this actor's current level/HP/abilities. Only works if you're the one who owns that character on the site. Continue?
DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.PushedToSite: Pushed {name}'s stats and token to the site.
DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.PushedStatsTokenFai: Pushed {name}'s stats to the site, but the token image failed to push: {error}

DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.SyncedThin: {name} was imported into the Vault manually (not via Pathbuilder), so only basic stats are available — level, current HP, and ability modifiers.
DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.PathbuilderCopied: The full Pathbuilder export for {name} was copied to your clipboard. On this actor, use the pf2e system's own "Import from Pathbuilder" option and paste it in for the complete build (skills, feats, spells, inventory) — this module only sets the basic fields directly, since that importer already does the hard part reliably.
DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.MissingTitle: Character No Longer on the Site
DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.MissingBody: "{name}" was linked to this actor, but it's been deleted from the D&D Amigos Character Vault. You can create a new entry from this actor's current data, or just unlink it.
DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.Unlinked: Unlinked this actor from D&D Amigos. Click Sync again to link it to a character or create a new one.
DNDAMIGOS.Menu.Title: D&D Amigos
DNDAMIGOS.Help.Title: How to Use This Module
DNDAMIGOS.Help.Sync.Title: D&D Amigos Sync (on each character's sheet)
DNDAMIGOS.Help.Sync.Body: On any PF2e character's sheet, click D&D Amigos Sync in the header. If the actor isn't linked to a Character Vault entry yet, pick one to pull its stats onto this actor, or create a new entry from this actor's current data. Once linked, clicking it again lets you choose Pull from Site (overwrite this actor with the site's data) or Push to Site (overwrite the site with this actor's current stats and portrait) — a campaign's DM can push for any character in it, not just their own.
DNDAMIGOS.Help.PostEvent.Title: Post Session Update
DNDAMIGOS.Help.PostEvent.Body: Sends a short message to the campaign's Discord, with the option to also log it as a real entry in the site's session log.
DNDAMIGOS.Help.ManageLoot.Title: Manage Loot
DNDAMIGOS.Help.ManageLoot.Body: Shows the whole Party Loot ledger in one popup, laid out like the site's own loot table — edit or remove any line (not just ones you added), or click + Add Loot to add a new one, credited to whichever member you've set as your identity. If a Loot Actor is configured (Configure Settings → D&D Amigos Connection), adding, editing, or deleting a line here keeps this world's shared Loot sheet in sync too.
DNDAMIGOS.Help.Lookup.Title: NPCs & Places
DNDAMIGOS.Help.Lookup.Body: Search the campaign's NPCs and Places, open one to read it, and add notes the whole party can see. Notes are shared with the website: anything you write here shows up there and the other way round. You can edit or delete your own notes (the DM can delete anyone's). You need to set your identity first (My D&D Amigos Identity) so your notes are credited to you.
DNDAMIGOS.Help.ImportInfo.Title: Import from D&D Amigos (GM only)
DNDAMIGOS.Help.ImportInfo.Body: Pulls the campaign's Places, NPCs, and Party Loot into this world as Journal Entries, and shows your E.Y.F.F.O. mini-game stats in a popup if you've set your identity and played it.
DNDAMIGOS.Help.Identity.Title: Setting Your Identity
DNDAMIGOS.Help.Identity.Body: Adding loot through Manage Loot, Post Session Update, and the E.Y.F.F.O. stats popup all need to know which D&D Amigos member you are so the right name gets credited. Set this once per browser under Configure Settings → My D&D Amigos Identity.

DNDAMIGOS.PostEvent.SuccessNoLog: Posted to Discord, but not logged to the session log — set your identity (Configure Settings → My D&D Amigos Identity) or link this journal to a DM account on the site.

DNDAMIGOS.Help.PushLore.Title: Push NPCs & Places to Site (GM only)
DNDAMIGOS.Help.PushLore.Body: NPCs and Places are written here, in Foundry, as pages in the "D&D Amigos: NPCs" and "D&D Amigos: Places" journals. Start a page with an italic line (the tagline), then the description. This button sends every page up to the site and remembers which is which, so pushing again updates the entry instead of duplicating it. A picture on the page becomes the portrait. The site shows plain text, so formatting is flattened. The "New NPC" and "New Place" buttons in the NPCs & Places window make a ready page for you.

DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.RestoreBody:
The site has all of {name} saved (last pushed {date}): inventory, spells, feats, skills and everything else.

Restore everything replaces this actor's items and data with that saved copy. Stats only just updates level, HP and abilities, and keeps the actor's items as they are.
DNDAMIGOS.ActorSheet.RestoreWrongType: The saved character is a "{saved}" but this actor is a "{actual}", so it cannot be restored onto it.
